page.title: Settings
page.subtitle: Notification filters & classification thresholds — applied to every book you subscribe to

tier.heading: Minimum tier
tier.desc: Every order book level is classified 0–4 by significance. Notify only levels at or above the tier you pick — anything lower is filtered out.
tier.captionAll: All tiers notify — nothing filtered by rank
tier.caption: Notifying tier {{min}}–4 · tier 1–{{prev}} filtered out

muted.heading: Muted tickers
muted.desc: Muted ticker + market books never trigger notifications. Search across all tickers to mute one.
muted.empty: No muted tickers — every book can notify

rules.heading: Per-ticker thresholds
rules.info: Each tier pairs a minimum notional with a maximum distance from mid-price. A custom rule replaces the default entirely for one ticker + market — all four tiers, every time.

yourRules.heading: Your custom rules
yourRules.desc: Tickers overriding the defaults. Every other ticker follows the default rule.
yourRules.empty: No custom rules — all tickers follow the defaults
